content: Name Dcm_ConfigType Kind Structure Implementation specific Type  Elements Comment  Description This type defines a data structure for the post build parameters of the DCM . At initialization the DCM gets a pointer to a structure of this type to get access to its configuration data, which is necessary for initialization. Available via Dcm.h
